metadata.smoothing_description: 10-day moving mean of percentile curves; extremes are not smoothed
metadata.daily_deduplication: median of profiles for the same calendar date
metadata.historical_time_caveat: Most historical Ljubljana soundings were nominally 06 UTC and are not fully time-equivalent to the current 00/12 UTC schedule.
metadata.pwat_method: MetPy precipitable_water from available dewpoint profile
metadata.pwat_qc: Dewpoint profile must begin within 50 hPa of the bottom of the sounding and extend to at least 300 hPa.
